summary: The root قنع (qnE) refers to a woman's head-covering, specifically one worn over a khimar, or a wider head-covering. It can also denote the pericardium, the integument of the heart.
lane: قِنَاعٌ ذ A woman's covering worn over the خِمَار [or head-covering ]; (Msb;) a woman's headcovering, wider than the . (S, K.) -b2- قِنَاعُ القَلْبِ The integument of the heart; the pericardium. (Mgh in art. خلع ; and K.)

headwords.def: تَقَّنَعَ بِشَىْءٍ He was content with a thing. (K, voce تعصّب.)

[not قُنْعَانُ, as in the CK,] With whom one is contented, or satisfied, (S, K,) like, (S, K,) in respect of his judicial decision, or his evidence: (K:) used a like as mase. and fem. and sing. and pl. (S, K) and dual. (S.)

A woman's covering worn over the خِمَار [or head-covering ]; (Msb;) a woman's headcovering, wider than the. (S, K.) قِنَاعُ القَلْبِ The integument of the heart; the pericardium. (Mgh in art. خلع; and K.)
as used in the Kur, xxii. 37, accord. to some, One who asks, or begs. (TA, art. عر.)
: see قُنْعَانٌ إِنَّ فِى ٰلِكَ لَمَقْنَعًا [ Verily in that is a sufficiency ]. (S, M, in art. سود.)
[and مِقْنَعٌ, PS] A woman's head-veil. (MA, PS.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
